images.title: Anu's list of weights
images.purpose: Put Anu's room in front of the student before any unit is explained: seven things and the weight she wrote for each one.
images.composition: A title at the top left, a row of seven plain things standing on one floor line, a tag with a recorded weight above each, and its name below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TITLE at the top left, x 60, y 56: the text Anu's list of weights in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (48 px, bold). ROOM STRIP: a thin grey #6B7280 floor line at y 640 from x 40 to x 1416. SEVEN THINGS stand on the floor line in one row, centres at x 120, 323, 526, 729, 932, 1135, 1338, each about 170 px tall with its base on y 640: 1, an iron almirah: a tall rectangle 100 by 170 px filled grey #6B7280 with one thin vertical centre line and two 8 px handles; 2, a bed: a low rectangle 170 by 70 px filled teal #0072B2 with a pillow rectangle 50 by 30 px at its left end and a headboard 18 by 100 px at its left edge; 3, a rice bag: a rounded rectangle 100 by 130 px filled amber #E69F00 with a tied neck 30 by 18 px on top; 4, a sofa: a rounded rectangle 160 by 80 px filled reddish purple #CC79A7 with two armrests 24 by 70 px at its ends and a back cushion 160 by 36 px above the seat; 5, a bucket: a trapezoid 110 px wide at the top and 80 px wide at the bottom, 100 px tall, filled teal #0072B2 with a thin curved handle arc over the top; 6, a water bottle: a rounded rectangle 54 by 140 px filled light teal #7FB8DA with a cap 24 by 20 px; 7, a refrigerator: a tall rectangle 110 by 170 px filled white with a thick dark outline, one horizontal dividing line at one third from the top and two 8 px handles. TAGS: above each thing a rounded rectangle tag 180 by 56 px (corner radius 12) at y 250 to 306, filled very pale grey #F3F4F6 with a 3 px outline #6B7280, centred on the thing's x, holding that thing's recorded weight in dark #1F2937 (36 px, bold): 40 g; 60 kg; 5 kg; 30 g; 1 kg 800 g; 650 g; 50 g. A thin grey line 3 px wide joins each tag down to its thing. NAMES under the floor line, centred on each thing at y 690 (32 px, dark #1F2937): Iron Almirah; Bed; Rice Bag; Sofa; Bucket; Water Bottle; Refrigerator. There are 7 things, 7 tags and 7 names, no tick, no cross and no other mark. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of things or tags that differs from 7
a tick, a cross, a comment or a correction anywhere in the frame
any weight other than 40 g, 60 kg, 5 kg, 30 g, 1 kg 800 g, 650 g and 50 g, or a tag on the wrong thing
images.takeaway: Anu has written a weight for each thing, and some of the weights look strange.
images.description: Seven things from Anu's room, each with the weight she recorded for it.
images.context: Concept image for the hook, Anu's Weight List. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (Anu's room and her list of seven weights) and says nothing about which weights are right.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student read each tag and wonder about it. Do not say which weights are right. The slip to watch: reading the number and ignoring the unit.

image_decisions.why: The seven things and their tags put the hook question, does this weight look right, in front of the student without giving the answer.
